subject: Warning message: Correlation between variables is (nearly):1.0

messages.author: 964993c75887caa8
messages.subject: Warning message: Correlation between variables is (nearly):1.0
parts:
Dear all,

When I try to fit the following model with lavaan:

formative3 <- '
             # latent variable definitions              
             #reflective
              mobility =~  lowspeedw1 + fewstandsw1
              senses =~ visimpw1 + hearimpw1
              vitality =~ lossweiw1 + lossappw1
              cognition =~ failyearw1 + failrecallw1 + faildweekw1 + faildmonthw1 + failmonthw1
              emotion =~ emptyw1 + nointew1 + nohopew1 + nohappw1
             
              depressionw2 =~ satisw2 + intew2 + fullifew2 + excitew2 + goodmow2 + nofearw2 + happyw2 + hopew2 +
              outhomw2 + goodmew2 + alivew2 + usefulw2 + promisw2 + fullenw2 + youbetw2
             
              MNArw2 =~ MNAa_w3 + MNAb_w3 + MNAc_w3 + MNAd_w3 + MNAe_w3 + MNAf_w3
             
             #formative
              ic <~ cognition + mobility +  senses + vitality + emotion
               
             # regressions
             depressionw2 ~ ic + HI8_w2 + man
             MNArw2 ~ ic + HI8_w2 + man
             cognition ~ HI8_w2 + man
             mobility ~ HI8_w2 + man
             senses ~ HI8_w2 + man
             vitality ~ HI8_w2 + man
             emotion ~ HI8_w2 + man
             ic ~ HI8_w2 + man
            '
fitformative3<- sem(formative3,data=hoy,ordered=c("fewstandsw1","lowspeedw1","visimpw1","hearimpw1","lossweiw1","lossappw1","failrecallw1","faildweekw1",
"faildmonthw1","failmonthw1","failyearw1","nointew1","emptyw1","nohopew1","nohappw1","satisw2","intew2","fullifew2","excitew2",
"goodmow2","nofearw2","happyw2","hopew2","outhomw2","goodmew2","alivew2","usefulw2","promisw2","fullenw2","youbetw2"))

(Note that almost all reflective indicators are declared as categorical, but those of MNAr)

I get more than 50 very similar warning messages. The first one says:

Warning messages:
1: In lav_samplestats_step2(UNI = FIT, wt = wt, ov.names = ov.names,  ... :
  lavaan WARNING: correlation between variables MNAa_w3 and visimpw1 is (nearly) 1.0


But the correlation between these two variables is:

> cor(hoy$MNAa_w3,hoy$visimpw1)

[1] 0.02931462


And the bivariate distribution:

> table(hoy$MNAa_w3,hoy$visimpw1,useNA="ifany")

            0    1

  0        7    0

  1    121    8

  2 1062   95


So, the warning must be signalling something else. Any idea?

Thank you,

Ángel

  0        7    0

  1    121    8

  2 1062   95


So, the warning must be signalling something else. Any idea?

This is from your full data set.  Are there missing values on other variables?  If so, you are using the default (missing = "listwise" rather than "pairwise"), so the table would look different if applied to a subset of complete.cases() rows in your data.
